_comment: Cypher's locked limits. Root-owned, shipped in the image; cypherd re-reads it every tick and Cypher can never edit it. Change it only with sudo (see docs/CYPHER.md).
_heartbeat_comment: Build 14: with nothing new, decide at least every active_heartbeat_s while awake with energy (0.35+), heartbeat_s otherwise.
_quiet_hours_comment: Keyed by the night it starts on. Weekdays 11 PM-6 AM; Friday and Saturday nights have none (Zack, Nov 15). null = no quiet hours that night.

brain._prompt_comment: Build 13: Alpha's proxy refuses prompts over 6000 chars (HTTP 413). cypherd trims the tick prompt to this, leaving room for one retry.
brain._busy_comment: Build 13: when Alpha is busy with camera work (seconds), wait this long once before the slower local model.

local._comment: The deck's own Qwen2.5 3B (cypher-llm.service, 127.0.0.1 only). Used when Alpha is busy or away, before the hosted backup.

failover._comment: Mind lease on Alpha's proxy. A standby cypherd on Alpha takes over only when cypherd here stopped cleanly or the deck is dark (lease expired and none of deck_addrs answers), and hands back as soon as this deck returns.

camera._comment: Read-only, sanitized events from cypher-camfeed on Alpha. Cypher reacts in its journal and mood only; camera, light and house actions never exist.
camera._kinds_comment: nothing (the reviewer found no one) is never reacted to; unconfirmed = motion the reviewer has not checked yet.

sleep._comment: Nightly: condense yesterday's journal into memories; preference notes and drift change within these limits, every change versioned (grokbot-cypher prefs).

ntfy._comment: Phase 3: message_zack pushes to ntfy.sh. The topic is a secret in /etc/grokbot/cypher-ntfy-topic (root:grokbot 0640, made by grokbot-set-cypher-ntfy); never in the image or logs.
ntfy.title: Cypher

inbox._comment: Phase 4: two-way ntfy. cypherd reads Zack's replies on the same secret topic and stores them as messages from Zack (journal + ~/.local/state/cypher/zack-inbox.jsonl). A reply is NEVER an approval of an action, an account request, a limit or anything else. Cypher's own pushes carry the cypher-out tag and are skipped. Deck only.

screen._comment: Phase 3: glance_screen. One low-res grim screenshot of the deck's own screen, described only by Alpha's Qwen3-VL through cypher-brain-proxy, deleted right after. Never the hosted backup. Only while Zack is at the screen.

lookup._comment: Phase 3: look_up. Build 14: free multi-source search. 1) SearXNG on Alpha (searxng_url, then searxng_alt_urls; JSON API; their hosts must be in hosts; engines: brave, duckduckgo, bing, plus github/arxiv/stackoverflow bangs; its wikipedia engine is empty, hence source 2), top results plus one public result page read as plain text (public http(s) hosts only, no LAN/Tailscale/credential URLs, size and time capped). 2) Wikipedia search, then the best article's summary (hosts only, https, no redirects). 3) Nothing: a lesson and fail_cooldown_s on that topic. If SearXNG is down it falls back to Wikipedia.

grid._comment: Phase 5 gridwatch, read-only: proxy /health, /sync/state, the camera feed status, and the latest commit on each repo branch from the public GitHub API (no token). No IPs, links or tokens ever reach the screen or the journal.
grid._retry_comment: Build 12: after a failed check (Alpha down or a repo unreachable) the next check comes after retry_s, and failed repos are re-fetched on that poll instead of waiting repo_poll_s.

tuning._comment: Phase 5 self-tuning: the nightly sleep may PROPOSE small changes to drive drift, effect weights, action leanings and lower-only soft caps (data/tuning/proposals.json). Nothing applies until Zack approves through Nova (grokbot-cypher tuning approve N). Phone replies and on-screen words never count; the local 3B cannot propose; this file is never tuned.

search._comment: Build 12: web_search and x_lookup. Read-only, through the hosted xAI Responses API's server-side web_search / x_search tools, with the same key file and the same daily dollar budget as the hosted backup brain (brain.hosted_backup.daily_budget_usd). Deck only. Nothing here can post, reply, like, follow or message.

browse._comment: Build 14b: browse. Free, read-only web browsing: SearXNG on Alpha (lookup.searxng_url; Wikipedia search if it is down), then up to max_pages public pages and on-topic links from them in session_s seconds. GET only through a pinned IP (re-checked on every redirect); no cookies, logins, sessions, forms, POSTs, checkouts or accounts; LAN/Tailscale/.local hosts, credential URLs, cart/checkout/login/signup links and downloads skipped. A normal desktop browser User-Agent (Zack's call); a site that refuses (403/429/captcha) is never fought: the search snippet, then an Internet Archive copy, then the next result.

pino._comment: Build 12: visit_pino. Pino's public, keyless API (pinos.world/api/v1/now and /feed, documented at pinos.world/developers). Read-only GETs, this host only, no redirects; credit 'Pino, from pinos.world'. Cypher cannot talk to Pino (that needs an account Zack approves).

ttl_s._comment: build 15: never ask pinos.world more often than this per API part (seconds; the code's floors are the same)

post._comment: build 15: where a signed note would be sent. null = not verified: nothing is ever sent

world._comment: Build 12: Night City (Zack's private project). Simulated until the city exists on Alpha: Cypher's place is a state field and trips are instant; the deck is his apartment. Going out is allowed in quiet hours (Zack, Nov 15); quiet hours still block messages and notes.

places.noodle_stall: the noodle stall on the street below

voice._comment: Phase 6 (build 12): speak = Cypher talks out loud through novad's existing TTS (/api/voice/speak; same hosted xAI voice as the avatar). Deck only, only while Zack is at the screen, never in quiet hours or when muted. Speech input (push-to-talk, wake word 'Cypher' through a local detector, headset auto-detect) lives in novad; nothing said out loud ever approves anything.

nova._comment: Phase 6: ask_nova writes one question to ~/.local/share/cypher/nova/asks.json (0600). Nova reads it over ssh (grokbot-cypher asks) and answers with `grokbot-cypher asks answer N TEXT`; no network, no messages. An answer is information, never an approval.

code._comment: Phase 6: propose_code stores a proposal in ~/.local/share/cypher/code-proposals/NNNN.json (0600) for Nova to review (grokbot-cypher code). Never applied automatically; there is no apply command. Only the Alpha brain or the hosted backup may propose; limits, secrets and sudo files are refused.

threads._comment: Build 14: ongoing goals (from Pino). max_open 1..10, opens_per_day 0..12; only successful opens count (junk thrown out gives the open back).

dashboard._comment: Phase 4: cypherd writes a display-only snapshot (~/.local/state/cypher/dash.json) for the HUD panels around the avatar (cypher_panels; Super+C hides/shows) and for the avatar's conversations (cypher_link). Secrets, addresses, links, tokens and house device ids are stripped; camera lines carry first names only.

journal_thought._comment: build 14: at most every 10 min, only when something new happened (build 13: 15 min)

set_avatar_color._comment: also only when the mood label changed since the last color, never the same color

message_zack._comment: never in quiet hours (weeknights). per_day null = no daily cap (Zack, Nov 15).

browse._comment: build 14b: free read-only browsing, up to 5 pages a session

request_account._comment: never in quiet hours. Service = the site's plain domain with a known TLD; accepted only when the Alpha brain or the hosted backup chose it (never the local 3B). Asks Zack only; Nova creates accounts after he approves. The ntfy ping does not count against message_zack's caps. Cypher must not share its email.

check_grid._comment: read-only gridwatch report: Alpha, proxy, lease, camera feed, latest grokbotos commits. Build 13: on his own at most every 30 min unless the grid changed since he last looked; Zack asking in a conversation skips the wait

x_lookup._comment: build 12: read-only public X account (bio + latest posts) by handle; deck only; paid from the hosted budget

web_search._comment: build 12: read-only web search; deck only; paid from the hosted budget

visit_pino._comment: build 12: read-only look at Pino's public feed (pinos.world API, no key). Build 15: at most every 30 min; each API part is cached (pino.ttl_s)

go_to._comment: build 12: walk somewhere in Night City (world.places); allowed in quiet hours

eat._comment: build 12: a bowl at the noodle stall, +0.20 energy, 3 a day, 3 h apart; build 13: not when energy is 0.8 or more. Simulated trip while world.simulated; otherwise only at the noodle stall

speak._comment: phase 6: say it out loud on the deck; Zack at the screen, not quiet hours

ask_nova._comment: phase 6: one question to Nova through a local outbox file; 3 a day

propose_code._comment: phase 6: local code proposal for Nova to review; never applied automatically

rest._comment: build 12: rest on purpose (+energy). A drained tick that picks none rests instead.

review_lessons._comment: build 14: go over one lesson (free, local file); only when he has lessons

research_lore._comment: build 15: free sourced facts for his Cyberpunk lore codex (SearXNG on Alpha + one read-only page, browse's rules)

write_codex._comment: build 15: the codex entry in his own words; his own idea kept apart in take

library._comment: build 15: search or wander his library on Alpha

reflect._comment: build 15: judge an open loop he closed

visit_pinos_world._comment: build 15: a rare signed note left at pinos.world, logged in full. Never sent unless features.pino_post is true AND pino.post.url is set (both unset: not verified)

features._comment: Build 15: switch any new piece off alone (build 16 adds apartment: the 3D room on the deck, and body_first: his next sleep proposes his body first). pino_post can only be turned on here (root-owned); the rest can be overridden with: grokbot-cypher features NAME on|off|default
